opportunities.title: Regular Grant (via Grants Portal)

amount.raw: up to £30,000 for local community capital projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations, exempt or excepted organisations with at least one year of audited accounts, operating in the UK, not having received a grant or application within the past year.
opportunities.summary: Open rolling application for regular grants to UK charities for operating/core costs or projects, submitted via the online Grants Portal.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations, exempt or excepted organisations with at least one year of audited accounts, operating in the UK, not having received a grant or application within the past year.
opportunities.summary: Open rolling application for major grants of at least £1 million total cost, for UK charities meeting eligibility criteria, via the Grants Management Portal.
